status_meaning: Completed tasks have bounded acceptance evidence. In-progress tasks retain open gates; pending tasks remain future work.
planning_deliverables: Detailed roadmap architecture validation risks and handoff

requirements.R16: Northern Germany Challenge when files supplied

optional_content_dependency_policy.condition: necessary Northern Germany Challenge input set has been identified and validated
optional_content_dependency_policy.rule: Do not infer absence from unknown status. Inspect the existing candidate pack first. Missing optional inputs may defer only the named NGC branch; do not block independently validated common Amiga media work. Do not close NGC acceptance without its inputs.
